Pod port-forward session

Source: R/portforward.R
PodPortForwardSession.Rd

Pod port-forward session

Pod port-forward session

Details

Returned by pod_port_forward_open(). Holds an open WebSocket and routes bytes between the user and the per-port data channels.

Public fields

ports

Forwarded remote ports (integer vector).

errors

Per-port error strings populated from the kubelet's error channels. errors[[as.character(port)]] is NA until set.

Method pump()

Dispatch frames that arrive within timeout seconds to the on_data() callbacks.

Usage

PodPortForwardSession$pump(timeout = 0)

Arguments

timeout

Seconds to wait for a frame (default 0, i.e. ~1 ms).

Returns

TRUE while the session is open, invisibly.

Method wait()

Block until the WebSocket closes or timeout elapses, dispatching frames in the meantime.

Usage

PodPortForwardSession$wait(timeout = 60)

Arguments

timeout

Seconds.

Returns

TRUE if the session ended naturally; FALSE on timeout.
